estimator: wick_factorized: c = (mean_blocks S)^2, S = -d phi(z) d phi(w) (z-w)^2
normal_ordering_definition: c_N = (L_w/(2N)) sum_j conj(k_j)^2, computed in closed form per realization from that realization's own momenta
self_estimation_bias: none: c_N is an exact conditional expectation given {k_j}, not estimated from the field samples
geometry_set: 48 points on a circle of radius 0.6; chord separations
uncertainty_method: block SE over independent named seeds; percentile bootstrap over blocks (20000 resamples, seed 20260730)
